summary: Core PDV flows are intact and wired. ~30% of components are dead code artifacts from the app decomposition refactor. Three IPC channels in preload lack main handlers. One security inconsistency with ifood:start-polling channel.

critical_findings.title: Ghost IPC channels without main handlers
critical_findings.details: app:check-unsaved-orders, app:shutdown (preload.js:88-89), clients:get-by-phone (preload.js:68,178) have no corresponding ipcMain.handle in main.cjs. Clients:delete-by-phone DB function exists but is never invoked via IPC.

critical_findings.title: ifood:start-polling security inconsistency
critical_findings.details: Channel has validator in validate.cjs but is NOT in preload.js ALLOWED_CHANNELS. Renderer code bypasses safeInvoke via legacy ipcRenderer.invoke(), so it works at runtime but violates the documented security architecture (AGENTS.md requires ALL channels in BOTH files).

critical_findings.title: Legacy App.jsx dead code (966 lines)
critical_findings.details: src/App.jsx is the pre-decomposition monolithic entry point. It is NOT imported by src/main.jsx or any live route. Replaced by src/layouts/AppLayout.jsx + feature screens. Should be deleted or archived.

critical_findings.title: BUY_X_GET_Y promotion type not handled in renderer
critical_findings.details: validate.cjs accepts BUY_X_GET_Y type. Main.cjs saves it. But calculateDiscount() in renderer (App.jsx:270-278, CheckoutScreen.jsx:34-42) only handles PERCENTAGE and FIXED_AMOUNT — BUY_X_GET_Y falls through to return 0 discount.

critical_findings.title: Unused APIs: inventory:get-low-stock, catalog:get-price-history
critical_findings.details: Both channels are exposed in preload and have main handlers + DB functions, but no UI element triggers them. Consider adding low-stock alert badges or price-history charts.

ghost_ipc_channels: app:check-unsaved-orders — in preload, no main handler
app:shutdown — in preload, no main handler
clients:get-by-phone — in preload, no main handler (getClientByPhone exists in db.cjs:852)

connection_chains_status.promotions_crud: ✅ intact (BUY_X_GET_Y discount not applied in UI)

files_read: Component index files and individual component sources
